description: Presentation only, never data: where a page goes when the general rule misplaces it. series maps a corpus key to its [site, series] folders, for keys the series pattern cannot read (an empty series files the key directly under its site); slugs maps a form or key to its file name; descs gives a folder its desc by hand, where the generated one would mislead.

descs.wiki/linear-a/inscriptions/LMP: The Keftiu incantation of the London Medical Papyrus (BM 10059), written in Egyptian group-writing, not Linear A.
